seo.title: Hosted in Quebec
seo.seo_title: AI hosted in Quebec for small businesses
seo.seo_description: Nexora AI hosts and runs your AI system in its infrastructure, located in Quebec. Location, backups, logs and subcontractors are specified in writing.

translation.headline: We host. You keep control.
translation.subheadline: We host and run your system in our infrastructure, located in Quebec. The documents that prove the location are in preparation: you will receive them in writing before go-live.

translation.title: The perimeter, with us.
translation.body: The diagram shows a typical perimeter: your team, our infrastructure in Quebec, your documents. It is an example, not a real customer's configuration; the diagram for your installation is handed over in writing.

items.title: What stays in our infrastructure.
items.text: Your system's documents, search index, conversations and logs.

items.title: What may leave.
items.text: Updates, licence checks, and an external model only if you accepted it in writing.

items.title: What we specify.
items.text: The hosting location, the location of backups and logs, and the list of subcontractors: in writing, before go-live.

blocks.role: Documents remis par écrit : statuts honnêtes (en préparation).

translation.title: What we hand over.
translation.intro: The hosted mode only makes sense if it can be proven. These are the documents we will hand over before go-live; they are in preparation.

cards.title: The hosting location.
cards.text: Address of the site and a location clause in the contract.

cards.title: The location of backups and logs.
cards.text: Where they are, how long they are kept.

cards.title: The list of subcontractors.
cards.text: Who takes part in the hosting chain, and where.

cards.title: The data-flow diagram.
cards.text: What stays inside the perimeter, what leaves it.

blocks.role: Qui fait quoi dans le mode hébergé.

cards.title: You.
cards.text:
You decide the use cases and the documents.
You approve the actions that commit the business.
You accept, or not, any external model.
You can export your documents, configurations and workflows.

cards.title: Nexora AI.
cards.text:
We host and run the system.
We apply updates and monitor.
We specify in writing locations, backups, logs and subcontractors.
We train your team in usage and supervision.

cards.title: In Quebec does not mean unconditional.
cards.text: Hosting in Quebec does not, by itself, set aside the laws that apply to you and your suppliers.

cards.title: Models matter as much as location.
cards.text: An external model called from our infrastructure is an outbound flow. It is configured only with your written agreement.

cards.title: No announced service level.
cards.text: Availability and response times are set out in the contract.

cards.title: No silent fallback.
cards.text: If a local model is unavailable, the system never turns to an external service without telling you.

items.question: Where exactly is my data?
items.answer: In our infrastructure, located in Quebec. The precise location, the location of backups and logs and the list of subcontractors are handed over in writing before go-live.

items.question: Is my data kept separate from other customers'?
items.answer: We describe the separation between customers in the deployment study, so you can have it checked. We assert nothing on the subject before documenting it for your case.

items.question: Do you use my data to train a model?
items.answer: No, not without your specific authorization. We do not reuse one customer's data for another customer or to train a model, and we put it in the contract.

items.question: What if I want to leave?
items.answer: You leave with your documents, configurations and workflows: export is provided for in the contract.

translation.title: Let's study your hosting.
translation.text: Tell us your uses and requirements. We will tell you what we would document: location, backups, logs, subcontractors.
